description: This file contains unit tests for the USBDevice component, including tests for device enumeration, device info retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event handling for device plug-in/out events. It uses Google Test framework and mocks for USB interactions.

classes.name: USBDeviceTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the USBDevice component, including setup and teardown of mocks and test environment.

methods.name: USBDeviceTest::Mock_SetDeviceDesc
methods.description: Mocks the device descriptor information for a specific bus number and device address.

methods.name: USBDeviceTest::Mock_SetSerialNumberInUSBDevicePath
methods.description: Creates mock serial number files for devices and device paths.
